column3: Rational Design and High throughput synthesis of nanocarriers for efficient drug delivery
column4: PUBLIC HEALTH RELEVANCE: The lack of quantitative structure-property relationship (SPR) in the self-assembly of polymer system limits the theoretical and computer-aided nanocarrier design for drug delivery. We have developed a well-defined highly engineer-able amphiphilic telodendrimer system which enables us to introduce drug-binding molecules (DBMs) in a combinatorial manner to optimize the drug loading properties of nanocarriers. We further propose to apply computational approaches in virtual screening of a natural compound library to identify suitable DBMs for nanocarrier library synthesis which allows for the methodology validation and systematic evaluation to improve anticancer effects of nanotherapeutics.
